neighbours.label: plural nouns that are not counted by a number (the samples, dedication ceremonies), the other side of the - pole's counted plurals (three parcels)
fire: However, the samples were limited to firms operating in the capital.
The cornerstone was laid in spring, but dedication ceremonies came later.
Please write the file names into the output directory first.
The museum keeps the records of every voyage in its basement.
After the storm, the volunteers repaired the fences along the road.
The professor graded the essays over the long weekend.
Local farmers sell the vegetables at the market on Saturdays.
The engineers tested the bridges after the earthquake.
quiet: However, three samples were limited to firms operating in the capital.
The cornerstone was laid in spring, but two ceremonies came later.
Please write five names into the output directory first.
The museum keeps four records of every voyage in its basement.
After the storm, twelve volunteers repaired the fence along the road.
The professor graded six essays over the long weekend.
Local farmers sell eight vegetables at the market on Saturdays.
The engineers tested nine bridges after the earthquake.

notes: - pole: plurals after a numeral (three parcels, fifteen volumes, five rings). Guessing + is the uncounted side.
